prediction.named_residual: smoothness of unsigned cycle_residual under continuous variation of the mix interpolation parameter. Predict: across 21 mix values uniformly spaced in [0, 1], no consecutive-step difference exceeds 5× the median consecutive-step difference.

kill_condition.rule: fail if max(|diff|) / median(|diff|) > 5.0 across the 20 consecutive diffs in the 21-sample mix sweep, where diff[i] = cycle_residual(mix[i+1]) - cycle_residual(mix[i])
kill_condition.rationale: A continuous parameter sweep on a continuous substrate should produce diffs of roughly comparable magnitude. A single diff that is 5× larger than the typical diff indicates the measurement is dominated by fingerprint-discretization boundaries rather than substrate dynamics. Such jumps mean interpretation across mix-parameter ranges must account for the discretization, not just the substrate.

verdict.rationale: max/median jump ratio = 2813.89, exceeds threshold 5.0. cycle_residual jumps discontinuously at fingerprint-quantization boundaries; interpretation across mix ranges must account for the discretization. Voice enters the null-voice ledger per §3.4.
